title: Approximate tangent spaces are invariant under dilations
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, M ⊆ ℝ^P, x, y ∈ ℝ^P, λ > 0, Q a linear subspace of ℝ^P and η = η_{x,λ}. If Q is the approximate tangent space of M at y in the sense of Simon 3.1.4 (SimonGMT HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M y Q: dim Q = n and ∫_{η_{y,r}(M)} f dHⁿ → ∫_Q f dHⁿ as r ↓ 0 for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^P)), then HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n (η(M)) (η(y)) Q.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (x y : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), 0 < lam → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M y Q → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n (dilation x lam '' M) (dilation x lam y) Q
